# Lesson 1 illustrations

OpenMoji artwork by the OpenMoji contributors: https://openmoji.org/
Source: https://github.com/hfg-gmuend/openmoji/tree/master/color/svg
License: Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike 4.0 International:
https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/

Downloaded source artwork: 26F9 (basketball), 1F483 (dancing), 1F4FA
(television), 1F3A7 (headphones), 1F35C (meal), 1F6B6 (walking),
1F3A4 (microphone), 1F4D6 (book), 2615 (tea), 1F3B5 (notes).

Adaptations: composed into lesson scenes with colored backgrounds, people,
seating and tables. Generated scene illustrations in this directory are
also distributed under CC BY-SA 4.0. Other application code is separate.

The illustrations replace low-resolution textbook crops; they are not
original illustrations from the textbook.
